data.name: Raku
data.gender_notes: Raku is used as a unisex name in hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The name Raku is recorded with the meaning “Joy, Calmness”. Raku is a Hindu name meaning “Joy, Calmness”. Families who choose it generally do so for the quality the name expresses. Note: this meaning has not been independently verified against a classical lexicon or primary source and is flagged for source verification.
data.spiritual_meaning: Raku expresses “Joy, Calmness”; spiritual readings of the name are interpretive.
data.etymology: The name Raku is recorded with the meaning “Joy, Calmness”. Raku is a Hindu name meaning “Joy, Calmness”. Families who choose it generally do so for the quality the name expresses. data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Raku total 15, reducing to 6. Number 6 is associated with responsibility, care and harmony.

in_marathi.name: Raku
in_marathi.long_meaning: Raku हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। One who brings joy and calmness

in_bengali.name: Raku
in_bengali.meaning: হিন্দু নাম যার অর্থ Joy, Calmness
in_bengali.long_meaning: Raku একটি হিন্দু নাম যা ভারতীয় সংস্কৃতিতে গভীর আধ্যাত্মিক তাৎপর্য রাখে। One who brings joy and calmness
